title: Criticality (A/B/C) rubric + canonical mandatory disclaimer text
context: Each phrase carries a criticality tier (A routine / B sensitive / C critical) that drives how intensively it is reviewed and whether back-translation or clinician sign-off is required. The rubric and the canonical mandatory disclaimer are foundational to the whole review and licensing pipeline. No pack ships without the disclaimer present verbatim.
objective: Author the A/B/C criticality rubric and the canonical mandatory project disclaimer text.
acceptanceCriteria: Rubric defines Tier A (orientation/basic-needs), Tier B (triage/evacuation instructions), Tier C (allergy/consent/breathing/bleeding/numbers-in-clinical-context) with decision rules and examples
Maps each tier to its required review intensity (2nd reviewer / back-translation / clinician sign-off)
Provides the canonical mandatory disclaimer wording verbatim, to be carried into every pack's attribution.txt in both pivot and target language
Rubric is machine-checkable enough to drive the CI structural check for tier presence and Tier-C back-translation
